thread:
maria: Heads-up — master CI is red after the renovate dependency bumps (noticed on the nightly run).
ci-bot: [failed] install-deps · test-matrix (ubuntu-22) · Job 3/5
ci-bot: ```
  ERROR: SolverProblemError
  Because package-x (2.1.0) depends on transitive-lib (>=3.0,<4.0) and package-y (1.4.0) depends on transitive-lib (>=2.0,<3.0), no versions of transitive-lib can satisfy both.
  Hint: Try updating the lockfile or pinning a compatible transitive-lib in pyproject.toml.
  ```
chris: Ugh, that looks like a transitive pin conflict from the renovate bumps. Which PR did it come from?
maria: renovate/dep-bumps-2026 (#402) merged ~2 hours ago — it had several minor bumps including package-x -> 2.1.0.
ta o: I'm on it. Trying to reproduce locally — running `poetry install` now.
jen: If it's the lockfile, CI usually fails with the solver error like that. We can either update the lockfile in the repo or revert the renovate PR. Which is faster? :thinking_face:
chris: Reverting would get master green faster. But we should confirm the minimal fix: maybe pin transitive-lib to <3.0 in pyproject for now or update package-y if compatible.
maria: Repro'ed locally: `poetry lock` fails with the same SolverProblemError. `poetry show -t` shows package-x -> transitive-lib >=3.0 and package-y -> transitive-lib <3.0.
ta o: I can try bisecting to confirm which bump introduced the incompatible constraint. Starting `git bisect` on master between the merge base and HEAD.
ci-bot: @maria triggered a rerun of job install-deps · test-matrix (rerun id: 3)
chris: while tao bisects, can someone try a quick fix: add `transitive-lib = "~2.9"` to pyproject.toml under [tool.poetry.dependencies] to force the older range? We may need to pin in pyproject to keep solver happy until upstream resolves.
jen: That will force poetry to select v2.x, but package-x requires >=3.0 so that might break package-x at runtime. Need to check package-x compatibility matrix.
maria: package-x 2.1.0 explicitly requires transitive-lib >=3.0 (see its setup metadata). Pinning to 2.x will make package-x unresolvable. Not safe.
chris: OK revert PR then. maria — can you open a revert PR for renovate/dep-bumps-2026 and mark it as [hotfix]? I can approve quickly.
maria: Done — opened #410 revert renovate/dep-bumps-2026 and started a CI run on the revert branch.
ci-bot: [queued] build for PR #410 (revert) · install-deps
ta o: Meanwhile I'll try to identify the minimal conflicting package. If package-x is the blocker, we should reach out to its maintainers or pin to an earlier package-x until they release a 3.x-compatible transitive-lib variant.
jen: Also let's add a short checklist in the revert PR description: "run `poetry lock` locally, confirm install passes, add note to upgrade package-x when transitive-lib gets a compatible version".
chris: If the revert PR passes CI, let's merge and then schedule a follow-up patch to re-apply the renovate bumps one by one in a separate branch to identify the compatible set.
maria: Revert PR CI is green on install-deps but failing a flaky test in tests/core::test-rate-limiter (unrelated). I'll hold merge until flaky test gets investigated.
ci-bot: [failed] tests/core::test-rate-limiter — timeout after 30s (flaky).
chris: Fine to merge the revert even if one unrelated flaky test is failing, as long as install-deps and lint steps are green. I'll approve and merge with admin if needed.
maria: Merged revert #410, master build retriggered.
ci-bot: [running] nightly pipeline on master · install-deps
ci-bot: [success] install-deps · test-matrix (ubuntu-22)
ci-bot: [queued] test-suite · tests/core::test-rate-limiter
ta o: Thanks — I'll continue digging on the transitive conflict and will open a PR that attempts to selectively reapply upgrades and updates the lockfile properly.
jen: Thanks all — great triage. If anyone wants to pair on the selective reapply, ping me. :thumbsup:
chris: cc @security (in case any bumped deps triggered CVE checks)
ci-bot: Security scan: no new CVEs detected in reverted PR.
maria: Closing loop — follow-up PR tracking is here: #415 (selective-dep-upgrades).
